steps.speaker: Fear Puppet
steps.content: Conscious human beings should not enter the Carnival, you shouldn't have come here... The Dancer hopes that you can leave.
Everywhere touched by the Ring is her realm. Without her permission, you're not even allowed to step inside.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: Go back... The park doesn't welcome humans, and obsession will only make you lose yourself. She won't see you, she never will...
That's not someone you can reach with your shackles. You can't go inside her heart, you haven't even received a hint of guidance about her whereabouts.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...You must go?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... That's not true... I'm not... I'm not scared...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=44>No...!</size>

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Are you alright?
She pauses, then obligingly places her hand on your stretched out hand. You grip her hand tightly.
You've already lost one companion, you can't lose another.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You still want to go inside the Carnival?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The crowd's attention is all on the performance now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: They've stopped paying attention to me just now. Rather than banishing an intruder like me, they care more about Hamel's upcoming performance.
The one that kicked you out was the white puppet, and you've already maimed it. Now you at least have a chance, Hamel's performance gives you the best chance.
Hella is still inside the illusory realm. She entered the Black Ring to protect you. No matter what, you must find her.
You stand up and walk forward, but the hand you're holding is briefly hesitant. Hecate doesn't follow you immediately. Her head is bowed and you can't see her face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I'm fine.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'll follow Chief's orders. I'll protect you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Let's go.
She catches up with your footsteps and you walk forward together, the old man's voice fading behind you.

steps.speaker: Old Man
steps.content: You... won't get to see her...

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: Parade

steps.speaker: Bunny Mascot
steps.content: Welcome to the Carnival! Welcome to the Carnival! The performance is about to begin! The performance is about to begin—!

You rejoin the parade. Like it did last time, the bunny mascot reaches out to sprinkle confetti over you. This time, the mascots have fallen into an even deeper mania, no one is aware of the presence of a human being.

But no matter which direction you go, you feel like you're not advancing at all. The buildings on both sides seem to be reappearing in a loop and strange music keeps interrupting your senses, and once you quit the parade, you'll be sent back to the beginning.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is a maze of illusions... We can't find the way forward.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then let's focus all our attention on the mascots around us.

steps.content: The mascots around you come and go in waves. You're certain some of them did successfully get to the destination, exit the parade, and get replaced by new ones.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I see. Then let's...
Hehehe...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Who are you?!
You suddenly notice a creepy little doll sitting on the shoulder of the mascot in front of you.

steps.speaker: Little Doll
steps.content: Are you here for the performance too? How I wish to see Hamel perform too!
The wooden doll wears a fluffy dress and has a winding key on its back. It's staring at you with a smile. Whenever it speaks, its chin twitches mechanically.

steps.speaker: Creepy Doll
steps.content: I know where she is, I know where she is!
The doll hops off the mascot's shoulder.

steps.speaker: Creepy Doll
steps.content: Follow me! Let's go and watch the performance together! Follow me!
The creepy doll's voice keeps luring you, tempting you to follow it into the depths of the amusement park.
It's so different from everything in this park, but somehow you have a vague memory of this feeling...
It's her!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... What should we do?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Grab onto me and follow it.

steps.speaker: Creepy Doll
steps.content: We're here! We're here! Come out!
It leads you out of the crowd, this time not to the park's entrance. You see an enormous Ferris wheel you've never seen before.
The marching crowd streams before you like a colorful river. On the other side of the river, you see a strange man clad in black.
The hood of the black raincoat covers his face. He stands out in the park, exuding an extremely ominous aura.

steps.speaker: Creepy Doll
steps.content: The audience are here! The audience are here! I want to perform too, I want to perform too! Let me dance!

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: ...Your wish... will be granted...

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: <size=44>I... witness!</size>
He raises his hand to cover his hidden face, crooked tentacles of smoke are seeping out from beneath the hood.
As if scorched by an invisible brand, a fearsome motif is left on the back of the hand. You recognize this motif...
You knew it. This Black Ring has to do with them too?!

The mark begins to burn and spread quickly, devouring his entire body within seconds. Amid the flames, his whole body is cramping, his hands are reaching toward the sky, and finally he lets out an unhuman growl.

steps.speaker: Man In Raincoat
steps.content: Roarrrr...!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Those flames are... contamination!!

Within seconds, he is burned to ashes like paper. Yet the black fire does not go out. It spreads to the surrounding marching crowd, creating a gap with its flames. The mascots that have caught fire scream painfully, instantly possessed.
In the center of the black fire, the creepy doll is absorbing everything around it. The fire envelops her body and she's growing bigger, her true form revealed from this nirvana...

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Hahahaha...! We meet again!

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: Come on, my dear audience, you want to see Hamel, don't you? Don't you want to see her dance?

steps.speaker: Phantom Hamel
steps.content: <size=44>I'll grant your wish!</size>
